headline: Clear the payment release queue faster without handing release decisions to a machine
capabilities: Validates payments against scheme rules and plans repairs
Prepares sanctions alerts and verification calls
Reconciles settlements and tracks nostro funding
Answers payment status inquiries and builds the daily KPI brief by rail
outcomes: Faster triage: failed payments arrive with a repair plan
Better releases: flags and evidence in one view
Earlier break resolution: breaks are ranked by value before the cutoff
why_try: The demo lets a payments operations lead ask a natural question and receive a source-backed, reviewable answer with the approval boundary visible in the response.
